subject: Intro: SolvDynamics demo — request for VP/CIO attendance

From: Anika Roy <anika.roy@solvdynamics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@solvdynamics.com>
Date: 2026-04-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: SolvDynamics demo — request for VP/CIO attendance

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro last week — Tom and I spoke internally and SolvDynamics is keen to see Redwood in action. Our CIO (Lina Verma) and VP of Engineering would like a short executive overview at the start of the session, followed by a 40-minute product demo that focuses on latency/cost controls and private deployment options.

Do you have a 60-minute window next week where a senior executive from Redwood can kick off the meeting? Our preferred windows are:
- Tue May 4: 10:30–11:30 PT
- Wed May 5: 14:00–15:00 PT

We can be flexible but Lina does need the executive portion in the first 10–15 minutes. Also: we will need the latest deck + a preliminary SOW to share with procurement after the demo. Could you confirm who will be the sponsor on your side?

Attaching our high-level objectives doc (attachment stub).

Best,
Anika Roy
Director of Partnerships | SolvDynamics
Anika.roy@solvdynamics.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: SolvDynamics_objectives.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@solvdynamics.com>
Date: 2026-04-26T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SolvDynamics demo — request for VP/CIO attendance

Hi Anika — great to hear, thanks for the clarity on goals.

Ben Carter (cc'd) will lead the demo; I'll serve as the exec sponsor for the intro. Ben will cover the runtime/throughput and autoscaling controls; I'll open with a 10-minute executive overview focused on production economics and deployment options.

Both May 4 10:30 PT and May 5 14:00 PT should work for us. Ben — can you confirm which slot you prefer? If neither, we can propose a fallback the following week.

Regarding materials: I attached a tailored demo deck (Product_Demo_Deck_Solvdynamics_v2.pdf) and an initial SOW template (SOW_initial_Solvdynamics.docx) — please feel free to share with procurement.

Next steps:
- Ben to confirm final slot and run-of-show
- I will request a short Lina-specific talking slide (one slide) from you if available
- We will send a Zoom link + calendar invite once the time is locked

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(650) 555-0122

Marissa / Anika — quick update from our side: Lina's calendar just tightened up. She cannot make Tue May 4 in the morning. Wed May 5 at 14:00 PT is still possible but it's a narrow slot — she needs to dial in at 14:00 sharp and may have to drop by 14:20 if an external press check runs over.

Would Redwood be ok with:
- 14:00 PT start, 10–12 minute executive intro (Lina will stay through the intro + first 15 minutes of demo)
- If Lina must leave early, can your VP brief a short decision checklist we can circulate to procurement after the call?

If that feels risky for your team, we can look at Thu May 6 16:00 PT or Mon May 10 11:00 PT as backups. Sorry for the late shuffle — appreciate the flexibility.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of GTM Ops | SolvDynamics
